conditions.runtime: Born in Bloom Living Path is active

change.summary: Make temporary Living Path leaves removable and allow controlled one-block descent

modifiers.before: Tracked temporary leaves reject block breaking and are immediately recreated over air
modifiers.after: Tracked leaves use ordinary block breaking and fire behavior. Their expiry record prevents same-coordinate recreation until expiry, while a newly exposed lower coordinate can receive the next path layer

rationale.purpose: Let players remove or burn the temporary bridge and intentionally descend one block at a time
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly requested ordinary break/fire behavior and lower-layer regeneration. Codex retained the existing saved expiry coordinate as the minimal anti-recreation tombstone

introduced.summary: Replace temporary-path break protection with breakable descending layers

history.summary: Remove break cancellation and skip already tracked coordinates during placement

relations: Vanilla oak leaves own drops and fire behavior
notes: Existing bridge duration and placement width/forward distance are unchanged
